name: I Promise You~!
source:
Cia is drowning in feelings she can’t control. She’s hopelessly in love with her childhood best friend, Clover. But—!! Clover’s heart already belongs to someone else! 

After missing school due to mental health struggles, Cia returns, desperate to reclaim what she lost. Can she win Clover back?

Or is she doomed to watch the love of her life choose someone else?

[From [url=https://cieloquest.itch.io/i-promise-you]Itch.io[/url]]
